title: THE ASH RIVER // GHOST GRASS BENEATH STYGAI
narrative: Along the black, poisoned waters of the River Ash, where fish swim blind and misshapen, the plains were overgrown with ghost grass: pale as milk glass, taller than a man on horseback, glimmering with eerie luminescent spores. Beyond lay the Corpse City of Stygai, where the sun never shines and shadowbinders weave demons from thin air. Melisandre recalled her youth as the slave girl Melony, sold to the red temple, learning to walk through the ghost grass without breathing the poisoned spores. Here at the edge of the world, she discovered that the Long Night was not an invasion, but an eternal cyclical reset of life itself.
